profile.text: Heidi, active in Victoria under a novelist's pseudonym, and simultaneously Kal'tsit's personal Messenger of many years. Arrested by Sarkaz forces owing to her participation in the Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps, and rescued when Rhodes Island entered Londinium, soon after formally joining Rhodes Island as an Operator.
